DEPARTMENT OF CHEMISTRY
&
CENTRE OF ADVANCED STUDIES IN CHEMISTRY
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH – 160 014, INDIA
Advertisement for the Ph.D. Position Under JRF
If you are highly motivated and passionate in organic synthesis to produce new molecules
for wide applications and want to work in the field of asymmetric catalysis, then this
position is for you!!!
Applications are invited for the appointment of JRF for PhD position in Dr. Jyoti Agarwal’s
research group. Candidates fulfilling the following eligibility criteria Details of advertisement
for applying for the position can be downloaded at http://puchd.ac.in.
Job Description: Design and synthesis of new chiral molecules, their enantio-separation
using HPLC and Development of novel processes for C-H activation reactions and their
applications in medicinal chemistry and material chemistry.
Note: The students will get the opportunity to work in various research institutes in tri-city.
Essential qualifications:
1. M.Sc. degree with at least 55% marks in Chemistry
2. Qualified NET-JRF and/or DST-Inspire and/or any other national fellowship
Desirable qualification: Experience in Organic Chemistry will be preferred
PI: Dr. Jyoti Agarwal, Department of Chemistry, PU
Ph.D. Position vacancy: 1 (One)
Salary: As per the CSIR/UGC Norms
How to apply: Interested candidates may email their applications (Performa is attached) with
detailed biodata (including contact number and email address) to jagarwal@pu.ac.in by 15th
June 2025.
Dr. Jyoti Agarwal
(Principal Investigator)
Department of Chemistry
Panjab University, Chandigarh
Note: The shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email along with interview date.
For any queries you can contact to PI at jagarwal@pu.ac.in or jyotiagarwa@gmail.com
Contact No. 9041905831
